_doc: Hover tooltips for packet ids in the paper (build.py PRERENDER_JS step 'packet tooltips').
ids: every 0xNN the text mentions as a packet id. The build fails on an id with no entry, so a new mention needs a line here.
sub: '<id> sub N' written in one run of text gets the sub's line appended. bf_sub: '... sub 0xNN' after 0xBF.
Names follow the Outlands client's own handler names (cuo_handler_table.json) and docs/PROTOCOL.md, docs/WORLDMODEL.md.

ids.0x00: 0x00 (C2S) Create character in stock UO. Here only an artifact: leftover bytes framed as an '0x00 packet' by a wrong length table, and an id from the misdecoded phantom stream.
ids.0x02: 0x02 (C2S) Walk request: one step in a direction (bit 0x80 = run), with a sequence number and a fastwalk key. 7 bytes.
ids.0x06: 0x06 (C2S) Double-click: use an object (hatchet, door, book, container). 5 bytes.
ids.0x08: 0x08 (C2S) Drop item into a container or onto the ground. 22 bytes on Outlands.
ids.0x0B: 0x0B (S2C) Damage: the number shown over a mobile that took damage.
ids.0x1B: 0x1B (S2C) Login confirm: the player's serial, body and position; the game scene starts.
ids.0x20: 0x20 (S2C) Mobile update: a mobile's body, hue, flags and position (on Outlands any mobile, not only the player). A jump in our own position is a teleport.
ids.0x21: 0x21 (S2C) Deny walk: the server refuses a step and puts the player back at x, y, z; the walk sequence resets. The proxy fabricates these toward the client as re-anchors after agent steps.
ids.0x22: 0x22 (S2C) Confirm walk: the server accepts the step with that sequence number (plus our notoriety).
ids.0x2F: 0x2F (S2C) Swing: an attacker swings at a defender (a fight in view).
ids.0x3A: 0x3A (S2C) Skills: the full skill list, or one skill's update (value, base, lock, cap).
ids.0x3F: 0x3F: no server-to-client handler in the Outlands client. In this paper an id the misdecoded 'phantom' stream produced.
ids.0x40: 0x40: no server-to-client handler in the Outlands client. In this paper an id the misdecoded 'phantom' stream produced.
ids.0x52: 0x52: no server-to-client handler in the Outlands client. In this paper an id the misdecoded 'phantom' stream produced.
ids.0x6C: 0x6C (both) Target cursor: the server opens a cursor ('what do you want to use this on?'); the client answers it with an object, a ground tile or itself. 27 bytes on Outlands (19 upstream).
ids.0x6F: 0x6F (both) Secure trade window between two players.
ids.0x78: 0x78 (S2C) Mobile incoming: a creature or player with its equipment entering view.
ids.0x91: 0x91 (C2S) Game-server login; on Outlands it carries the account and the session JWT.
ids.0x9E: 0x9E (S2C) Vendor sell list: what an NPC will buy from you.
ids.0xAD: 0xAD (C2S) Unicode speech; keyword-encoded like the stock client when speech.mul matches.
ids.0xB0: 0xB0 (S2C) Gump: a server-defined dialog (layout, text, buttons).
ids.0xB1: 0xB1 (C2S) Gump response: which button was pressed, plus switches and text entries.
ids.0xB9: 0xB9 (S2C) Enable client features: the expansion flags the server allows.
ids.0xBF: 0xBF (both) Extended command, with subcommands. Sub 1 seeds the fastwalk token, sub 2 pushes another, sub 4 closes a gump, sub 0x13/0x15 ask for and pick from a context menu, sub 0x19 carries extended stats.
ids.0xC0: 0xC0 (S2C) Graphical effect (hued): a spell, sparkle or explosion. 52 bytes on Outlands (36 upstream).
ids.0xC1: 0xC1 (S2C) Cliloc message: a numbered localized string with arguments.
ids.0xC8: 0xC8 (both) View range. The server sets it at login (18 tiles on Outlands); the client forgets what lies beyond it.
ids.0xDC: 0xDC (S2C) Object property list revision: the tooltip hash of an item or mobile.
ids.0xEF: 0xEF (C2S) Login seed. Stock clients send 21 bytes with the client version; Outlands sends a 5-byte cleartext preamble, ef 00 00 00 0c (protocol version 12).
ids.0xF3: 0xF3 (S2C) World item: an item or a multi (house) entering view. 38 bytes on Outlands (26 upstream).
ids.0xFF: 0xFF (both) Outlands' own protocol envelope, with subcommands: 0 handshake (the 13-byte prelude), 3 time sync (the keepalive), 4 cast spell, 5 the once-a-second range-prune tick, 8/9 buffs, 0x15 item names, 0xDEAD corpse data.

0xBF.1: Sub 1: fastwalk seed; arms the token the next walk must carry.
0xBF.2: Sub 2: pushes one more fastwalk token.

0xFF.3: Sub 3: time sync, the client's ~1/s keepalive and the server's reply.
0xFF.5: Sub 5: ProcessDeletes, empty, about once a second; the client drops every mobile and item beyond its view range.

bf_sub.0x13: 0xBF sub 0x13 (C2S) Context-menu request: ask an NPC or house steward for its menu.
bf_sub.0x15: 0xBF sub 0x15 (C2S) Context-menu pick: the entry chosen from that menu.
bf_sub.0x19: 0xBF sub 0x19 (S2C) Extended stats: a bonded pet's status (subtype 0) or stat locks (subtype 2).
